# SI022 — evidence-fetched-without-cap

Fetched evidence must be scrubbed and capped before prompting.

## Why

Unbounded pages blow the prompt budget and make validator cost unpredictable.

## Bad

```python
text = gl.nondet.web.render(url)
```

## Good

```python
text = _scrub(gl.nondet.web.render(url))[:max_chars]
```

## Suppression

```python
# safetynet-disable-next-line SI022 -- reason
```
